versions.content: Handling if EthSwt_MacSecAddRxSa is called and Eth- SwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecAddRxSa is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthSwtPort identified with the given SwitchPortIdx at the EthSwtConfig identified with the given SwitchIdx • a reception secure association can be added to the given association number (see An ), i.e. the given association number is not occupied then the EthSwt driver shall perform the following actions. Otherwise return with E_ NOT_OK : • create a reception secure association at the Ethernet switch port that corre- sponds to the given SwitchPortIdx at the Ethernet switch that corresponds to the given SwitchIdx by considering the given association number (see An ), the lowest acceptable packet number (see LowestPn ), the short secure channel identifier (see Ssci ) and the secured association key (available via KeysPtr and addressed with SakKeyPtr ) • activate the created reception secure association, if given API parameter Active is set to TRUE , otherwise deactivate reception secure association • return with E_OK .
